notes_for_editor: Only the Forest Lookouts listing names this tower. Record coordinates (30.7012, -85.7635) lie about 1.8 km from Wikipedia's community point (30.71306, -85.75139); no source gives the tower's position, so no correction is proposed. Forest Lookouts also has a Five Points, Indiana entry (five-points.html, Jefferson County), a different lookout that is not used here. No build, height, staffing, fate or photo source found.
